ev.q: The percentage of decedents aged ≥85 years who died while a hospital inpatient decreased from 40% in 1989 to 29% in 2007.
The percentage of decedents aged ≥85 years who died at home increased from 12% in 1989 to 19% in 2007.
Forty percent of these deaths occurred in nursing homes or other long-term care facilities.
